suppress.notes:
Added 2026-11-09. httpclient5 5.5.1 is reached only as the copy shaded into docker-java-transport-zerodep, which Testcontainers uses at test scope to start the PostgreSQL the tests run against. It never runs in the deployed application, which neither packages nor loads it. The client talks only to the local Docker daemon through its socket, and the responses of that daemon are not attacker input, so nothing an attacker controls reaches the defect.
Mitigation: The client exists only while the tests run on a machine that already trusts its own Docker daemon. The entry is removed once Testcontainers or docker-java releases a transport whose shaded httpclient5 and httpcore5 carry the fix.
